about: E.I.D.- Parry (India) Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of sugar, ethanol, cogeneration, nutraceuticals, and consumer products in India, North America, Europe, and internationally. The company offers sugar for use in food, bakery, confectioneries, beverage, and pharmaceutical industries; and grains, such as millets and dals, as well as rice.
